notes.title: Update 23548
notes.content:
We've been busy updating the game, but we haven't written a release notes in more than a month, so I thought I'd make a list of things we've done. If you haven't played in a while, I think you'll be surprised with how much the game has improved!

[list]
[*] Huge amount of stability fixes.
[*] Full implementation of Team Play
[*] Randomize character appearance with hair color and facial hair
[*] New chase camera for vehicles
[*] Support steam invitations, and joining friends games
[*] Keep waypoints from jumping around
[*] Many sound improvements
[*] Make sure that when players leave the game, they drop their items
[*] Improve time of day transitions
[*] UI improvements
[*] Fixed issue with guns being wildly inaccurate
[*] Switch solution for decals. Now you can see bullet holes, etc.
[*] Added blood spray, and scorch mark decals
[*] Added a tutorial
[*] Remove "Host" and "Join" buttons in favor of "Play" button, since all games are identical, and you can join your friends using the steam invitation/join system.
[*] Improve the accuracy of bullet collisions on some complicated objects (guard towers and such)
[*] Hold vehicles for a time before they respawn, and make sure they won't kill anyone when they come back.
[*] Fix many, many issues with item spawning
[*] Fix pickup drops when player dies in a vehicle
[*] Don't "leak" items from the game
[*] Fix issues with ragdolls in vehicles
[*] Make sure the bloody construction helmet works!
[*] Improve some models
[*] Fix a large amount of particle issues
[*] Added some achievements
[*] Reduced the poly count of clothing pickups
[*] Fix issues with bullets and grenades under water
[*] Improve wakes on the boats
[*] Added separate Voice Volume slider.
[*] Added a new building
[/list]

notes.title: Update 23241 - Team Mode and Weapon Attachments
notes.content:
This has been our biggest update yet. We have introduced Team Mode which brings us closer to our final vision of the game. Now you and your friends can occupy different seats of vehicles, and work together to get off the island. Right now pressing 'T" during a game opens the team screen, all feedback welcome as usual. 

In addition we have added weapon attachments. There is a large range of scopes, silencers, lights to customize your weapons. 

Since we now have lights, the lighter, and the glow sticks and flares we have went back to the really dark nights.

In addtion we have prepped some vehicles for team play. the Hind now seats 8 with 3 gun positions. There is a patrol boat and a gun boat, so you can defend yourself out at sea, and we have a new Mig. 

In addtion there has been several visual and stability improvements, and the addtion of host migration. 

Please let us know what you think.

notes.title: Update 22836
notes.content:
Hey guys,

Good stuff coming tonight:

[list]
 [*] Vehicles have working lights (driving at night is possible now)
 [*] Introduced a way to light dark interiors when there are no lights to turn on*
 [*] Make light switches glow softly so you can find the damn things
 [*] Increase walkable angle to 50 degrees so you can go up steeper terrain
 [*] Fixed issues with vehicles getting stuck moving between forward and reverse
 [*] Attempted to improve hit detection when target is moving across your field of fire. Should make hitting people in vehicles easier in a fair way
 [*] Added a cause of death message to the "you-died" screen
 [*] Various stability improvements
[/list]

* The thing we added is a test of a portable light source. I called it a Glow Puck(tm) lol. They look like little green discs. When you find one, walk up to a wall (or a jeep, or a deer), go to your inventory and double click the Glow Puck. It will stick to whatever you're looking at (within a meter or two). It only stays around for 40 seconds, so move quick!

Thanks everyone, and we'll see you in a few minutes

-Headshots

notes.title: Update 22694
notes.content:
Hello testers!

We are working hard to fix stability problems, and we think we're making good progress. We can't tell unless we get a lot of people playing, though, so I'm hoping you guys will be willing to play with us a bit more as we iron out these difficulties.

We play every Thursday night at 7 pacific time

This new version focuses on in-game stability improvements (as opposed to stability while joining which will come with the next update in a few days).

Version 22694 includes the following fixes/changes:

[list]
[*] Fix issues with containers / vehicles leading to invalid states on client machines
[*] Make sure the inventory avatar is in a casual, devil-may-care posture
[*] Make sure the game doesn't pause if the player clicks outside the window or alt-tab's to another program (happens a lot because the cursor just stops being locked sometimes). Should help server stability
[*] Fix issue with cursor not staying locked
[*] Try to ensure that if steam drops a player from the lobby, that player is made aware of it. Should stop ghost player bug.
[*] Make sure you can't tread water forever (by increasing hunger rate over time when swimming)
[*] Put in better effects and muzzle flashes for some vehicle and weapons
[*] Fix issues with multiple death messages
[*] Fix issues with the lock-on indicator in aircraft
[/list]

This is the part of the project that is always the most difficult. You think you've accounted for everything during the long, careful development process.  Late nights and early mornings spent pouring over timelines and UML charts. Then, the instant a real player touches it, you're shown how wrong you were. It's heartbreaking and anxiety inducing for both players and developers. 

I want to thank you again for helping us with this process. I know it's disappointing and frustrating, and you are still helping us. I can't say thank you enough times.

- Headshots
